Prams and pushchairs are carried free of charge in addition to your normal baggage allowance, meaning they will be checked in. They are generally not permitted in the cabin due to their size.

"Thanks for clarifying that, Sky. So, just to confirm, I can bring my pram onto the flight, but it'll need to be checked in at check-in and there won't be any extra fee for it. And what about the extra checked bag - is there a fee for that?"

You can add the extra checked bag to your booking now, and the payment will be processed online through a secure link that will be sent to your email address. Could you please provide me with your booking reference number so I can add the extra bag for you?

I understand you don't have your booking reference with you. However, I recommend trying to find your booking reference so we can add it to your booking now, as this often streamlines the check-in process.

"I'll try to look that up, but I don't think I'm going to be able to get my booking reference with me right now. I've got a lot of stuff in my bag and it's all over the place. Is there any way we can just confirm that everything is covered before I head home?"

I understand it's difficult to find your booking reference right now. Unfortunately, I can't access or modify your specific booking details without that reference number.

To add the extra checked bag to your booking, I would need the reference. If you can't find it, you will still be able to add and pay for the extra bag when you check in at the airport, though the fee might be higher than if you added it online in advance.

"I completely understand, Sky. I appreciate your honesty. I think I'll just have to go with adding it when I check in at the airport then. The extra £35 shouldn't make a huge difference, and I'd rather be safe than sorry. Is that okay with you?"

Yes, that is absolutely fine. You can certainly pay for the extra checked bag when you check in at the airport. Just be aware that the fee might be higher than if you were to add it to your booking in advance. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
"Actually, no, Sky, everything is fine. Thank you so much for your help and patience - I really appreciate it. Perfect, thank you so much."
